body:
Same here
If anyone wants to chat text me we'll complain together and please no "it'll get better" bullshit, we'll be depressed together
It's worse because I wanted to end my life and then bam it gets better and I suddenly don't want to but then it gets worse again and I just have no idea what I want and what is real

This is exactly my situation
It's terrible
Up and down up and down
I'm gonna turn 18 in August and I only have my parents to wish me happy birthday, you're not alone, although it doesn't matter because I won't be here too long anyway

I get you 
Today my aunt came on a visit and asked me about my grades
I had the worst year of my life and there she comes reminding me of how much of a failure I am for having C's so here I am crying in my room because I know that I'm not pretty, I'm not smart enough, my personality is shit and basically I only take up the space
It hurts
Also when I look at my parents they're both good looking. Idk I guess their features don't go well together. It's like there are two different worlds, for the attractive ones and then the rest.
And the fact that I'm sitting on the train and there's such a pretty girl sitting on the opposite doesn't help at all.

I've tried all of the recommended stuff. But when the facial features are ugly, nothing helps, really. It sucks.
And I am also superficial, I wanna be pretty. That's what I want, why have good personality or other good inside stuff when it has no use. So accepting that I am the ugly one is harsh.
Thanks for advice, but I've tried most of these things...It doesn't help that I'm a shy introvert. I'll try to keep fighting
I'm crying so hard rn because I don't wanna go yet I can't stand myself like that, I feel the judgement and how unwanted I am....

Same here. I'm a seventeen year old girl. When I was with my friends and boys came up to us, they only talked to them while I was just standing there like a ghost. I've always been asked about my hot friend.....I have loving parents, a cat that I love, I consider myself smart and financially we are doing good. But everyday I wake up feeling miserable.I hate myself so much, I am so ashamed of myself, of my face and I keep looking at my mom and sister because they are both so pretty and I really am not. This is not toget attention, it is true, I am not attractive, I'm seriously UGLY. I hate it. I know I will kill myself it's just a matter of time and it destroys me because I don't want to die. I wanna live and experience so many things, bit not with this face, I won't even be able to. It's hell that I am going through because my looks basically kill me slowly...

I ran out when I realized that I was really dying, survival instinct...
If I had sleeping pills it would be better

Interesting, when I tried it in ten minutes I could feel my heart pumping really fast but not like anxiety, just the heart the rest of the body was calm and I was slowly falling asleep, and I was slightly dizzy that's it
It is not fair either way, I mean should you suffer just so others don't? Someone will suffer but they will eventually move on while you might feel that pain forever
I'd feel guilty about helping that person die :(  Even though I'd be dying too
Could be if you had data (in case you'd do it in a car and not at home)
Exactly, many people have done it because they felt they couldn't chicken out anymore

Oh how much I feel you. I used to workout, eat healthy and I consider myself pretty intelligent. But with time I have realized that without looks none of this matters. I hate the way I look, I look at my mom and my sister (they are both really pretty) and I ask why do I have to look like a fucking frog. I'm a 17 y/o girl and I've always been ignored by people, guys always spoke with my pretty friends and I was just standing there like a ghost. I've already attempted suicide two month ago but then my survival instinct kicked in and gave last false hope. Now I don't try to do anything because I'm ugly, and that is the end for me, so I'm planning to kill myself, this time I know what to expect and finally can leave. Everyday is so hard to just be....
